claims: Alexia Jayy won Season 29 of The Voice on Tuesday, April 14, 2026.
Season 29 of The Voice is subtitled Battle of Champions.
Adam Levine was Alexia Jayy's coach.
Alexia Jayy is 31 years old.
Alexia Jayy is from Mobile, Alabama.
Alexia Jayy is a singer.
Alexia Jayy became the first African-American female to win in the history of The Voice.
The results of the Season 29 finale of The Voice were determined by a studio audience comprised of former The Voice artists and superfans.
Liv Ciara was the runner-up in Season 29 of The Voice.
Kelly Clarkson was Liv Ciara's coach.
Lucas West placed third in Season 29 of The Voice.
John Legend was Lucas West's coach.
Mikenley Brown placed fourth in Season 29 of The Voice.
Kelly Clarkson was Mikenley Brown's coach.
Alexia Jayy's win marked Adam Levine's fourth overall win as a coach on The Voice.
Alexia Jayy's win was Adam Levine's first win as a coach on The Voice since Season 9.
Adam Levine is tied with Kelly Clarkson for the second-most wins as a coach on The Voice.
Blake Shelton has more wins as a coach on The Voice than Adam Levine and Kelly Clarkson.
During the Season 29 finale, Alexia Jayy performed Patti LaBelle's "Lady Marmalade".
During the Season 29 finale, Alexia Jayy performed Adele's "One and Only".
During the Season 29 finale, Alexia Jayy performed a duet of "Sunday Morning" with Adam Levine.
Alexia Jayy released her single "Rent Free" on April 15, 2026.
Alexia Jayy received a home recording studio as a prize.
Alexia Jayy received a full year of internet and mobile services provided by Xfinity as a prize.
